limitations.title: Limited statistical power
limitations.scope_note: Power: low-hundreds episode counts; wide intervals.
limitations.description: Episode counts are in the low hundreds (140 generated, 36 true windows in the validation split) and cluster-bootstrap intervals are correspondingly wide. Several ablation differences are not distinguishable from zero at 5% FDR.

claims.claim: The non-significant microstructure ablation is uninformative rather than evidence that the contribution is zero, because the observed difference is smaller than the minimum detectable effect at this episode count.
claims.evidence: Minimum detectable effect 0.000185 against an observed difference of 0.000176. The bootstrap half-width scales with an exponent of -0.59, close to the textbook -0.5.
claims.statistical_test: bootstrap power curve; half-width scaling exponent estimated by log-log regression

claims.claim: Diluting a real training set with copula-generated rows above roughly a quarter of its size reduces AUPRC on real validation rows, and the reduction tracks lost interaction structure rather than distributional distance.
claims.evidence: REAL ONLY 0.9390 (sd 0.0020) against REAL + SYNTHETIC 0.3870 (sd 0.0266), a difference of -0.5521 against a 0.0088 seed noise floor. The share sweep reads 0.9412 at 0 percent, 0.9439 at 10, 0.9429 at 25, 0.9076 at 50, 0.3856 at 75 and 0.3613 at 81. Five candidate mechanisms are not supported: mean KS 0.0028, positive-rate ratio 1.01, mean pairwise correlation error 0.0216, effective-rank ratio 1.11, zero out-of-range values, and no memorisation at a nearest-neighbour distance ratio of 1.42. The supported mechanism is interaction loss: a tree ensemble separates real from generated rows at AUC 0.9639 while a linear model reaches 0.4952.
claims.statistical_test: three paired seeds against a 0.0088 seed noise floor; a share sweep at 0/10/25/50/75/81 percent; six candidate mechanisms measured, decided by the AUC gap between a tree ensemble and a linear discriminator
claims.dataset: panel-features shard, 9,351 real training rows and up to 40,000 generated rows; scored on 3,855 real validation rows
claims.experiment: CORPUS-03 real vs synthetic; CORPUS-05 degradation diagnosis

last_run.message: The multi-seed driver that produces repeated measurements for the existing bootstrap, permutation, Benjamini-Hochberg and power machinery to consume is not implemented. Tracked as STATS-16 in research_modules.yaml. Until it runs, every reported figure remains a single-run result. No output was written and no value was substituted.

figures.caption: Mean AUPRC over ten seeds with the observed range, for the strongest arms. The spread is what a single-run difference has to exceed.

tables.caption: STATS track: AUPRC across 10 seeds per ablation arm. Pooled seed sd 0.00316; 95% noise floor 0.00877.
